meta.descricao: Thinking of selling your property? João Domingues, real estate consultant, supports the whole sale from start to finish, with closeness, transparency and security.

hero.eyebrow: Real estate consulting for property owners
hero.titulo: Sell your property with strategy, security and support.
hero.texto: From the first contact to the deed, I guide the whole sales process closely and transparently. Start by understanding what your property may be worth on the market.
hero.vender: I want to sell my property

port.texto: See how I present the properties in my care. Yours could be next.
port.semJs: Enable JavaScript to see the properties I represent.

pedido.texto: Tell me a little about your property and what you are looking for. I will get in touch to understand your situation and explain the next steps.
pedido.v2: Support at every stage of the sale

form.objAvaliar: Find out how much my property is worth
form.prazo: When do you want to sell
form.mensagemPh: Briefly describe the property and what you need. If you prefer, just leave your contact details.
form.consentimento: I authorise João Domingues to contact me in response to this request, under the Privacy Policy (GDPR). *
form.erroTelefone: Please enter a valid mobile number.
form.obrigado: Thank you, {{nome}}! Your request has been prepared on WhatsApp. I will get back to you as soon as possible.

sobre.lema: By your side, from first contact to the deed.
sobre.p1: Selling a property is an important decision. My job is to understand your goal and your moment, so the sale is handled clearly and without surprises.
sobre.p2: With close support and a personalised approach, I take care of every stage of the sale, so you can decide with confidence and transparency.
sobre.cta: I want to sell my property

como.texto: From valuation to the deed, every stage of the sale is supported in a personalised way.
como.p1d: Understand your property, the area and the market to set a realistic price.
como.p2d: Present the property to the right audience, with carefully prepared photos and description.
como.p3d: Support viewings and offers, and negotiate on your behalf with transparency.
como.p4d: Follow the paperwork through to the deed, for a secure sale.

cta.titulo: Selling well starts with a conversation.
cta.texto: Tell me what you have and what you are looking for. I will listen to your case, answer your questions and explain the next steps, with no obligation.

rodape.tagline: Real estate consulting for those who want to sell their property in Portugal.
rodape.lema: My goal is to help you make your dream come true.

modal.convite: Have a property to sell? Talk to me and I will show you how I can present it.
modal.vender: I want a result like this

jd-001.resumo: Spacious bedrooms, plenty of natural light and fitted wardrobes.
jd-001.descricao: 2-bedroom apartment in a building with a lift, a few minutes from the metro and local shops. Spacious bedrooms with fitted wardrobes, wooden flooring and excellent sun exposure. Ready to move in.

jd-002.resumo: Good storage, a full bathroom and an entrance hall.
jd-002.descricao: Functional 1-bedroom apartment with an entrance hall, a full-wall wardrobe and a complete bathroom. An example of how I present functional properties, highlighting storage and space.

jd-003.resumo: Balcony with open views, in a quiet residential area.
jd-003.descricao: 3-bedroom apartment in a well-kept building, with a balcony and open views over the city. Easy street parking, with schools and transport nearby.

jd-004.resumo: An extra room for an office or home gym.
jd-004.descricao: 2-bedroom apartment with a multipurpose room, currently used as an office and gym. Large windows, a wooden work surface and good light throughout the day.
